senses.definition: comparative form of short: more short.
examples: There are two routes to get there. We're in a rush so we'll take the shorter one.

quotes.text: Basingstoke-Exeter will test this. From Salisbury westwards, it's largely single-track since British Rail downgraded it in 1967. There's a ten-mile loop between Templecombe and Yeovil, as well as shorter loops at Chard, Axminster and Honiton.

senses.definition: (colloquial) A short, a short seller: one who engages in short selling.
(UK, slang, obsolete) One who makes a dishonest profit by clipping and filing coins.

quotes.text: My grandfather, as I said before, was connected with a gang of shorters, and sometimes shortened money, […]
